priceSnapshot.source: OKX Public API v5 (market/ticker, BTC-USDT), fetched via in-page fetch() from the okx.com origin using Claude in Chrome (WebFetch through the sandbox proxy returned a ticker ~22h stale this run, discarded per the freshness guard). Same in-browser method used for all BTC candles/derivatives/liquidation data.
priceSnapshot.note: Up +0.20% since midnight's close (84,011.6 -> 84,181.1) but -0.61% on the 24h window (open24h 84,696.4). Calm grind higher overnight into morning, session range since midnight a tight 83,967.8-84,340.2 -- both reduceIf 82,874.5 and addIf 84,944.4 stayed well clear, untested for a 6th straight session/since yesterday morning respectively. Funding cooled sharply (+0.0026% at midnight -> +0.00074% now) and the L/S account ratio eased back (1.36 -> 1.32), while OI held essentially flat ($2,395.6M -> $2,387.7M) -- the overnight long re-build partially unwound rather than extended.

reduceIf.confirmation: Unchanged since the Sep-24 flush -- untested for a 6th straight session. A settled 1H close below 82,874.5 would end the hold and signal the recovery has failed. Session low since midnight (83,967.8) stayed well clear.

addIf.confirmation: Unchanged since yesterday morning -- still capped by the 84,724 close and the 85,258.8 wick. A settled 1H close above 84,944.4 would confirm the range top is breaking. Session high since midnight (84,340.2) stayed well under it.

decisionBox.changed: No level change: reduceIf (82,874.5) and addIf (84,944.4) both carry forward untouched. What moved since midnight: funding eased notably (+0.0026% -> +0.00074%), L/S account ratio pulled back (1.36 -> 1.32, less crowded), OI roughly flat ($2,395.6M -> $2,387.7M), while short-term momentum kept improving (1H MACD hist +10.44 -> +36.45, daily MACD hist +245.32 -> +256.50, a second straight tick-up). Net effect: the overnight long-crowding partially cooled even as price and momentum both edged higher -- a healthier, less leveraged version of the same range-bound bullish tilt, hence position stays HOLD.
